errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save. We put it back the way it was.

dev.title: Developer tools
dev.notProduct: Review screens, not part of the product.

sections.chips: Chips · single choice (Paid by) and tags
sections.itemAvatars: Avatars per item · your name in bold

samples.sheetBody: Sample sheet. Close it by tapping outside, on the X or with Esc.
samples.optimisticHint: Changes right away; the second one flips back after 1 s, with an error toast.

paletteTool.intro: Change a color and watch the whole app change. Nothing is saved to the code: when you like it, use "Copy CSS" and paste it into apps/web/src/theme/tokens.css.
paletteTool.copyFallback: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the text below and copy it.

home.guestBanner: No account yet. Your splits are saved on this device.
home.emptyBody: Start one for the trip, the barbecue or Secret Santa and stop doing math on napkins.

create.title: New split
create.name: Split name
create.addHint: A name is enough. Invite by link later and each person picks who they are.

created.title: “{{name}}” is ready!
created.body: Share the link in the group chat. Whoever joins picks their own name.

join.title: Join a split
join.body: Paste the link you got or type the split code.
join.codeErr: Type a code or paste the invite link
join.info: No account needed to look: join, pick your name and see your share.

who.title: Who are you?
who.body: Pick your name to see your share.
who.newHint: You join as a new participant with no expenses yet. The split admins see you arrived and can add you to expenses.

people.inviteBody: Anyone with the link joins and picks their name.
people.lockB: You are a member of this split. To invite, promote or remove someone, ask {{who}}.

leave.title: Leave “{{name}}”?
leave.body: Your name stays in the split, with its expenses, and becomes free for someone else to pick. You stop seeing this split.

blocks.balanceRemove: {{name}} still has a balance of {{amount}}. Settle up before removing.
blocks.inExpenses: {{name}} is part of expenses in this split. Edit them before removing.

reasons.invalid-input: Check the details and try again.
reasons.invalid-code: We couldn’t find that invite. Check the code with whoever invited you.
reasons.name-taken: There’s already someone called {{name}} here. Tell them apart, e.g. {{name}} G.
reasons.name-claimed: Someone already picked {{name}}. Pick another name or tap “I’m not on the list”.
reasons.not-guest: That’s only for people without an account.
reasons.invalid-recovery: This recovery link no longer works.
reasons.invalid-merge: Couldn’t merge the accounts. Log in again and retry.
reasons.merge-choice: Pick which name to keep in each split.

entry.tagline: Split costs for trips, barbecues and Secret Santa. No spreadsheets, no awkwardness.
entry.terms: By continuing you accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

email.toSignin: I have an account · Log in
email.toSignup: I don’t have an account · Sign up
email.resetSent: We sent you a link to change your password
email.weak: The password needs at least 6 characters.
email.inUse: This email already has an account. Log in with the password.
email.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a bit and try again.

auth.merged: Your splits came over to your account

merge.title: Bring your splits over
merge.body: You logged into an account that already existed. The splits on this device come along. Where you show up with two names, pick which one to keep; the other becomes free for someone else.

nudge.title: Save your account so you don’t lose this split
nudge.body: You are the admin without an account. Clearing the browser or switching phones loses access.

recovery.title: Don’t lose your splits
recovery.body: Keep this personal link. If you switch phones or clear the browser, just open it to be you again, no password or email.
recovery.label: Your recovery link
recovery.warn: Anyone with this link gets in as you. Don’t share it in the split group.
recovery.active: You already saved a recovery link on {{date}}.
recovery.invalid: This recovery link no longer works. Ask whoever has access for a new one or log in another way.

account.title: Your account
account.name: Name
account.callHint: Your name shows in bold under your avatar so you can spot yourself quickly.
account.passwordSub: We’ll send you a link to change it
account.notifsWhy: We let you know when someone marks they paid an expense you covered.
account.inappB: Shows on the bell when you open the app
account.emailGuest: Available once you save your account
account.askProofT: Ask for a receipt when marking as paid
account.askProofOn: When marking paid or received, we open a screen to attach a receipt (optional).
account.askProofOff: Marking paid or received confirms instantly. You can send a receipt later.
account.guestLogoutB: Without an account, logging out takes your splits off this device. Keep the recovery link first.

invite.confirmB: The current link and code stop working. Whoever already joined stays in the split.
